transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’ve been… really jumpy lately. Like at work, if a door slams or someone drags a suitcase fast through the lobby, I sort of jump out of my skin. It feels like it’s happening again, and it takes me a bit to calm my heart down.
Do you ever feel sudden episodes of intense fear or discomfort that peak within minutes, like a panic attack?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t call it that, exactly. I get startled and really uncomfortable, but I’m not sure it peaks like a panic attack.
Have you ever had an episode where you suddenly felt intense fear, your heart raced, or you felt like you couldn't breathe, even when there wasn't a real danger?
Not really, no. I mean, I get shaken up sometimes, but I don’t think I’ve had that kind of… can’t-breathe episode out of nowhere.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried most days, even when there isn’t a specific reason for it?
I’m not sure. I wouldn’t say I’m worried most days for no reason… it’s more just when something sets me off, I guess.
Do you ever avoid certain places or situations because you're afraid you might have a panic attack or feel trapped or embarrassed?
I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not really avoiding places because I’m scared of that happening… not that I’ve noticed.
Do you find yourself feeling tense or anxious a lot of the time, even when there’s nothing specific bothering you?
Not really a lot of the time, no. I mean… I get tense sometimes, but I usually feel like there’s some reason for it.
Do you often feel restless or on edge, even when things seem okay around you?
Not really often, no. I mean… I can get a little keyed up sometimes, but if things are fine around me, I usually don’t feel that way.
Have you noticed that you feel anxious or on edge specifically in certain situations or around certain things, even if you know they aren’t really dangerous?

Yeah… certain noises, I guess. Like if a door slams, or someone rolls a suitcase really fast across the lobby, I just… jump. It feels like it’s happening again for a second. Takes me a minute to calm back down.
Can you think of a time when something happened that might explain why these sounds bother you so much now? Like, do these sounds remind you of something stressful or scary that happened before?

Yeah… I guess it’s tied to that guest at the desk. Sometimes I’ll just get this image, out of nowhere, of him leaning over the counter and knocking the equipment toward me. Even if I’m just trying to answer a normal call, it pops in my head.
Can you tell me more about what happened with that guest at the desk? Was there a specific incident where you felt scared or unsafe?

Yeah… there was. I don’t really like going into it, but… he leaned over the counter at me and knocked some of the equipment toward me. Since then, it’ll just pop into my head sometimes, like a picture of it happening again, even when I’m just doing something normal like answering the phone.
Do you find yourself having vivid, distressing memories or flashbacks of that incident with the guest, where it feels like you’re reliving it all over again?

Yeah… not like I totally lose where I am, but it’s vivid. Out of nowhere I’ll get that picture of him leaning over the counter, the equipment coming at me. Even if I’m just answering a normal call, it just shows up, and it’s… upsetting.
